p: rebuke me not in thine anger: Though I deserve destruction, yet let your mercy pity my frailty.
bones are vexed: For my whole strength is abated.
My soul is also sore vexed: His conscience is also touched with the fear of God's judgment.
death there is no remembrance of: He laments that opportunity should be taken from him to praise God in the congregation.
Depart from me: God sends comfort and boldness in affliction, that we may triumph over our enemies.
suddenly: When the wicked think the godly will perish, God delivers them suddenly, and destroys their enemies.
